answer: In our decentralized topology, sybil swarms seek a haven to forge false weight, yet our matrix factorization rejects unearned transitivity. Reputation has an exponential temporal half-life requiring sustained honest service; freshly spawned sybil identities possess near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot pass consensus. Like brittle shale crushed under continuous verification, artificial clusters shear off before scaling the trust ridge required for state transitions.
